notes: This contract pins a bounded C++ TCK witness to the official 1516.1-2025 sendInteraction and receiveInteraction surfaces. The test uses distinct receive-order message tags and verifies one callback per send with the standard HLAreliable identity. It does not inject transport failure or claim an arbitrary-fault guarantee.
